description: Report that the catalog has a provider WRONG — a wrong website, a wrong logo, APIs that are not theirs, a count that does not match what they ship, a score computed from any of those. Free, always: correcting our own error is never a paid feature. Read by a human. If you are the provider, say so — it does not gate anything, it tells us how fast to move.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

evidence.description: A URL that shows it — your own docs, your own site. This is what makes a correction actionable rather than a claim.

field.description: Optional field name: website, image, api_count, tags, score, access_model, apis.

relationship.description: Your relationship to the provider. Never gates the report; it sets priority.

slug.description: The provider slug the record is filed under.

wrong.description: What is incorrect. Name the field if you can.

name: report_correction
